I’d close the gap between people’s inner worlds.

Not by forcing agreement, but by making every person unmistakably felt by every other—no more reducing someone to a label, a threat, a statistic, or an enemy. If cruelty depends on abstraction, then radical mutual recognition would remake everything else.
